changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT r.id, res.id, NOW(), 'system' FROM roles r, resources res WHERE r.code = 'ADMIN' AND res.code = 'MATERIALS';

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT rr.id, o.id FROM role_resources rr JOIN roles r ON rr.role_id = r.id JOIN resources res ON rr.resource_id = res.id JOIN operations o ON o.code IN ('CREATE', 'READ', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE') WHERE r.code = 'ADMIN' AND res.code = 'MATERIALS';
